title: Theorem
body_md:
\bigskip \noindent We have \\

\bigskip \noindent (a) If the following conditions $ \frac{a_{n}\left( f,s\right) }{s_{n}\left( f,s\right) }\rightarrow 0$ and $
B_{n}\left( f,s\right) \rightarrow 0$  hold as $n\rightarrow +\infty ,$ then 
\begin{equation*}
\frac{a_{n}\left( f,s\right) }{s_{n}\left( f,s\right) }\left[ M_{n}\left(
f,s\right) -\gamma ^{s}\right] \rightsquigarrow \mathcal{N} \left( 0,\gamma
^{2s}\right) .
\end{equation*}

\bigskip \noindent (b) Furthermore, if  

$$ \frac{a_{n}\left( f,s\right) }{s_{n}\left( f,s\right) }\rightarrow +\infty $$ 

 \bigskip \noindent then

\begin{equation*}
\frac{a_{n}\left( f,s\right) }{s_{n}\left( f,s\right) }\left[ M_{n}\left(
f,s\right) -\gamma ^{s}\right] \rightsquigarrow \mathcal{N} \left( 0,\gamma
^{2s}C^{2}\left( s\right) \right) .
\end{equation*}
 \label{doubldhilltheo}
